metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for developer productivity

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Self-configuring Claude Code status line — model/effort, git & PR status, context window, session churn, and rate-limit monitoring, plus per-subagent rows in the agent panel

plugins.name: gittools
plugins.description: Git and GitHub workflow utilities for Claude Code — a worktree-safe default-branch fast-forward after merge, and a race-proof wait for PR CI to go green

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: GitHub issue management utilities for Claude Code — create and fix issues with codebase context

plugins.name: claude-memory-sync
plugins.description: Cross-machine sync for Claude Code's per-project memory and user-scope instructions — git-backed private state repo with AI-assisted semantic merge

plugins.name: ui-tester
plugins.description: A shared Tester session that runs UI test plans with computer use, and the routing skill other sessions use to send it checks

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Subagent orchestration for Claude Code — oversee an issue or task end to end with each phase delegated to a subagent, and name sessions after their issue
